questions.question:
**Given here are f our sentences. The first sentence is in the correct order, while the rest of the sentences are jumbled. Pick the options that give their correct order.**

A. The computer company was in a crisis as its sales and profits were falling.

B. He immediately set to work chopping jobs and taking other tough decisions.

C. Soon things started changing and the company was saved, at least in the short term.

D. The board brought in a new CEO with many years of experience who began managing the crisis.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"ADBC"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence is fixed as the question says. The first sentence states the crisis of the company.
 
 
• The computer company **was in a crisis** as its sales and profits were falling.
 
 
 
• The next sentence must be D because it tells about bringing a new CEO to manage the crisis.
 
 
• ​The **board brought in a new** CEO with many years of experience who began managing the crisis.
 
 
 
• The next sentence must be B it states the decision taken by the new CEO.
 
 
• ​He **immediately set to work chopping jobs** and taking other tough decisions.
 
 
 
• The last sentence will be C as it states the temporary recovery of the comapany.
 
 
• ​Soon things **started changing** and the **company was saved, at least in the short term**.
 
 

**Hence the correct order will be:** *The computer company was in a crisis as its sales and profits were falling. The board brought in a new CEO with many years of experience who began managing the crisis. He immediately set to work chopping jobs and taking other tough decisions. Soon things started changing and the company was saved, at least in the short term.*
